DEEM optimization of three ideal wind farms and Horns Rev 1

source_assets.author_data: no paper-linked public numeric archive located

fixture.claim_boundary: declared source-backed proxy, not author arrays

model_contract.wake: target Eqs. (1)-(11), target Eq. (8) interpreted literally with z0, RSS superposition

horns_turbine.power_and_ct: linear interpolation of declared digitized knots

model_contract.minimum_spacing: non-strict >=5D, because target Fig. 4 uses exactly 5D while Eq. (13) is typeset as strict >5D
model_contract.objective: minimize Mosetti fixed-count cost divided by expected power

optimizer_contract.encoding: one turbine coordinate is one DE individual; one population is one layout
optimizer_contract.mutation: DE/rand/1 with F=0.9 and three mutually distinct non-target turbine indices
optimizer_contract.crossover: target Eq. (18), CR=0.9, at least one mutant coordinate
optimizer_contract.replacement: each offspring replaces a random layout turbine and is accepted sequentially only when whole-layout expected power improves
optimizer_contract.initialization: direct-predecessor random feasible placement, at most 200 relocation attempts before restart
optimizer_contract.budget_and_repeats_authority: direct DEEM predecessor because the target omits both

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: target Eq. (13) is strict >5D but Fig. 4 contains ten 200 m-spaced turbines with D=40 m
target Eq. (8) prints z0 while direct wake predecessor Eq. (18) uses reference height z
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: primary target paper takes precedence; use z0

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: target calls the problem grid-based but omits both ideal and Horns grid sizes
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: infer the ideal 200 m grid from Figs. 4-6 and declare a 200 m Horns proxy from Fig. 12

hpc_contract.algorithm_specific_acceleration: Wang et al. moved-turbine cache reduces a feasible trial from O(S*N^2) full evaluation to O(S*N)
hpc_contract.active_semantics: offspring generation uses a layout snapshot; acceptance remains sequential and in turn
hpc_contract.inner_parallelism: persistent full-core state parallelism when S*N is heavy
hpc_contract.outer_parallelism: independent light paper cases and seeds fill Waffle cores when inner parallelism would be slower
hpc_contract.formal_resource_policy: maximum twenty aggregate Waffle CPU workers with no nested oversubscription

claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of all 29 paper-native problem/stability combinations and predecessor-completed DEEM; not author code, private arrays, exact grid, random state or exact numerical replay
